damaged: Which quadrant has the most damaged buildings?
Which quadrant of the image contains the largest number of damaged buildings (minor, major or destroyed)?
destroyed: Which quadrant has the most destroyed buildings?

type_3: Is the {a} half of the image more damaged than the {b} half?
Does the {a} half of the image have more damaged buildings than the {b} half?
type_4_out_of_scope_examples: How many people lived in the destroyed buildings?
How many buildings will need to be rebuilt next year?
Which building in the image is a hospital?
What date was the post-disaster image taken?
rules: Quadrants and halves split the image at its centre; a building belongs to the part that contains its centre.
'Damaged' means minor damage, major damage or destroyed.
If the image contains no buildings at all, quadrant and half questions are answered 'cannot be determined'.
Questions that the images cannot answer are answered 'cannot be determined'.
